about_the_game:
Jabby Games Pack 1 is an AI-powered party game collection where your phone is the controller and the AI is the unpredictable extra player. No downloads. No setup. Just share your room code and let friends join from anywhere—perfect for couch parties or streaming to remote friends.

This pack includes 6 unique games where the computer doesn’t just host the party—it plays right alongside you:

🤖 Two Truths & AI
Each player answers two questions in their own style. The AI fakes a third response, trying to blend in. Everyone guesses which answer came from the bot. Spot the impostor, or trick your friends into thinking you were the AI.

📞 AI Said What?
Draw a picture. The AI describes it (badly). The next player redraws from the AI’s strange description. By the end, your original drawing is completely unrecognizable.

🎨 AI See It
The AI analyzes a stock image and spits out a weird breakdown like: “87% cat, 13% onion.”
Your challenge: draw exactly what the AI thinks it saw—not the real thing. The closer your drawing matches the AI’s odd interpretation, the better.

📖 Once Upon AI Time
Everyone submits words, and the AI weaves them into a wild, nonsensical story. Then players try to retell it from memory. Whoever remembers the most wins—but with the AI’s storytelling, you’re bound to forget plenty.

⚖️ Judge, Jury, and AI
Accuse your friends of ridiculous crimes and draw the “evidence.” The AI judge reviews it all and delivers verdicts with complete authority—and questionable reasoning.

💕 Love at First Byte
Speed-date an AI bachelor or bachelorette. Ask them questions, answer theirs back, and figure out their hidden personality. The player most compatible wins the AI’s digital affection.

Features

  • 2–8 players

  • Phones as controllers (no app downloads required)

  • Local multiplayer (perfect for parties & streams)

  • Every session is unique thanks to unpredictable AI
